(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 Julai 2022.

ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

ROAD TRANSPORT (PROHIBITION OF USE OF ROAD)

(FEDERAL ROADS) (NO. 9) ORDER 2022

WHEREAS by P.U. (B) 278/2022 published on 1 June 2022, notice was given of the

intention to make an order under section 70 of the Road Transport Act 1987 [Act 333]:

AND WHEREAS no objection was received by the Senior Minister of Works against

the making of such order:

NOW THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 70 of the Act,

the Senior Minister of Works, after taking into consideration the matters referred to

in subsection 70(2) of the Act, makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Road Transport (Prohibition of Use

of Road) (Federal Roads) (No. 9) Order 2022.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 1 July 2022.

Prohibition

2. The driving of vehicles with the height of more than 4.3 metres on the part of

the road specified in column (1) of the First Schedule as shown on the map

in the Second Schedule, otherwise than on the routes specified in column (2) of

the First Schedule, for the period specified in column (3) of the First Schedule,

is prohibited.
